qe: Choose the correct verb: “She ___ to school by bus every day.”
qh: सही क्रिया चुनिए: “She ___ to school by bus every day.”
e: The singular subject “she” takes “goes” in the simple present tense.
eh: एकवचन कर्ता “she” के साथ सामान्य वर्तमान काल में “goes” आता है।

qe: Choose the correct article: “He is ___ honest officer.”
qh: सही article चुनिए: “He is ___ honest officer.”
e: “Honest” begins with a vowel sound because its h is silent, so “an” is used.
eh: “Honest” में h मौन है और शब्द स्वर-ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए “an” प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Complete the sentence: “Good learners depend ___ regular practice.”
qh: वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: “Good learners depend ___ regular practice.”
e: The standard expression is “depend on” something or someone.
eh: मानक प्रयोग “depend on” है, अर्थात किसी पर या किसी चीज़ पर निर्भर होना।

qe: Choose the correct passive form: “The workers built the bridge in 2020.”
qh: सही passive रूप चुनिए: “The workers built the bridge in 2020.”
o: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.
oh: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.
e: The simple past active changes to “was/were + past participle”; “bridge” is singular, so use “was built.”
eh: Simple past active का passive “was/were + past participle” होता है; “bridge” एकवचन है, इसलिए “was built” सही है।
oe: The bridge was built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge is built by the workers in 2020.
The bridge had build by the workers in 2020.
The workers were built the bridge in 2020.
The bridge built the workers in 2020.

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: She said, “I am tired.”
qh: सही reported speech चुनिए: She said, “I am tired.”
o: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.
oh: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.
e: With a past reporting verb, “am” normally backshifts to “was,” and “I” changes to “she” to match the speaker.
eh: भूतकालीन reporting verb के बाद “am” सामान्यतः “was” हो जाता है और वक्ता के अनुसार “I” बदलकर “she” होता है।
oe: She said that she was tired.
She said that I am tired.
She says that she was tired.
She told that she is tired.

qe: Choose the correct conjunction: “___ it was raining, the match continued.”
qh: सही conjunction चुनिए: “___ it was raining, the match continued.”
e: “Although” introduces a contrast: the rain did not prevent the match from continuing.
eh: “Although” विरोध दर्शाता है: बारिश के बावजूद मैच जारी रहा।

qe: Choose the antonym of “scarce.”
qh: “Scarce” का विलोम चुनिए।
e: “Abundant” means plentiful and is the opposite of “scarce,” which means limited or insufficient.
eh: “Abundant” का अर्थ प्रचुर है; यह सीमित या अपर्याप्त अर्थ वाले “scarce” का विलोम है।

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning to “cautious.”
qh: “Cautious” के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: “Cautious” means careful to avoid danger or mistakes.
eh: “Cautious” का अर्थ खतरे या गलती से बचने के लिए सावधान रहना है।

qe: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
qh: सही विराम-चिह्न वाला वाक्य चुनिए।
e: An exclamation mark is appropriate for a sentence expressing strong feeling or admiration.
eh: प्रबल भावना या प्रशंसा व्यक्त करने वाले वाक्य के अंत में विस्मयादिबोधक चिह्न उचित है।

qe: Read: “Mina waters the seedlings each morning. She keeps the soil moist but avoids flooding the pots.” Why does Mina avoid flooding the pots?
qh: पढ़िए: “Mina waters the seedlings each morning. She keeps the soil moist but avoids flooding the pots.” मीना गमलों में पानी भरने से क्यों बचती है?
o: The seedlings need moisture, not waterlogged soil
The seedlings grow only in dry sand
oh: पौधों को नमी चाहिए, जलभराव वाली मिट्टी नहीं
पौधे केवल सूखी रेत में उगते हैं
पानी पौधों की हर वृद्धि रोकता है
वह केवल रात में पानी देती है
e: The passage says she keeps soil moist but avoids flooding, so the seedlings need moisture without waterlogging.
eh: अनुच्छेद कहता है कि वह मिट्टी नम रखती है पर पानी से भरने नहीं देती; पौधों को नमी चाहिए, जलभराव नहीं।
oe: The seedlings need moisture, not waterlogged soil
The seedlings grow only in dry sand

qe: Choose the correct verb: “Each of the players ___ a uniform.”
qh: सही क्रिया चुनिए: “Each of the players ___ a uniform.”
e: “Each” is singular, so it takes the singular verb “wears.”
eh: “Each” एकवचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ एकवचन क्रिया “wears” आती है।

qe: Complete the sentence: “By the time we arrived, the film ___.”
qh: वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: “By the time we arrived, the film ___.”
e: The film began before another past event, so the past perfect “had begun” is appropriate.
eh: फ़िल्म पहले शुरू हुई थी और आगमन बाद की भूतकालीन घटना है; इसलिए “had begun” सही है।

qe: Choose the correct preposition: “Maya is interested ___ astronomy.”
qh: सही संबंधसूचक अव्यय चुनिए: “Maya is interested ___ astronomy.”
e: The standard expression is “interested in” a subject or activity.
eh: किसी विषय या गतिविधि में रुचि के लिए “interested in” प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Choose the correct relative pronoun: “The doctor ___ treated my brother was kind.”
qh: सही संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम चुनिए: “The doctor ___ treated my brother was kind.”
e: “Who” refers to a person performing the action in the relative clause.
eh: “Who” संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य में कार्य करने वाले व्यक्ति के लिए आता है।

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, “We are ready.”
qh: सही परोक्ष कथन चुनिए: He said, “We are ready.”
o: He said that they were ready.
He said that we are ready yesterday.
oe: He said that they were ready.
He said that we are ready yesterday.
oh: उसने कहा कि वे तैयार थे।
उसने कहा कि हम कल तैयार हैं।
वह कहता है कि वे तैयार था।
e: In reported speech with a past reporting verb, “we” changes with context and “are” usually backshifts to “were.”
eh: भूतकालीन reporting verb के बाद संदर्भानुसार “we” बदलता है और “are” सामान्यतः “were” बनता है।

qe: Complete the first conditional: “If it rains this evening, we ___ indoors.”
qh: प्रथम शर्तवाचक वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: “If it rains this evening, we ___ indoors.”
e: The first conditional uses present simple in the if-clause and “will” plus the base verb in the result clause.
eh: प्रथम शर्तवाचक में if-clause में present simple और परिणाम में “will” के साथ मूल क्रिया आती है।

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning to “brief.”
qh: “Brief” के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: “Brief” means short in duration or length.
eh: “Brief” का अर्थ अवधि या लंबाई में छोटा/संक्षिप्त है।

qe: Choose the antonym of “expand.”
qh: “Expand” का विलोम चुनिए।
e: “Contract” means to become smaller, the opposite of “expand.”
eh: “Contract” का अर्थ सिकुड़ना है, जो “expand” का विपरीत है।

qe: What does the idiom “break the ice” mean?
qh: मुहावरे “break the ice” का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Make people feel more comfortable at the start of an interaction
Break an object made of ice
oe: Make people feel more comfortable at the start of an interaction
Break an object made of ice
oh: बातचीत की शुरुआत में लोगों को सहज करना
e: “Break the ice” means to reduce initial awkwardness and help conversation begin.
eh: “Break the ice” का अर्थ शुरुआती झिझक कम करके बातचीत शुरू करना है।

qe: In “The team carried out the survey,” what does “carried out” mean?
qh: “The team carried out the survey” में “carried out” का क्या अर्थ है?
e: “Carry out” means to perform or conduct a task.
eh: “Carry out” का अर्थ कोई काम करना या संचालित करना है।

qe: Choose the correct possessive form: “The ___ room was tidy.”
qh: सही संबंधसूचक रूप चुनिए: “The ___ room was tidy.”
e: For a plural noun ending in s, the possessive is formed with an apostrophe after the s: “students’.”
eh: s पर समाप्त होने वाले बहुवचन संज्ञा का संबंधसूचक रूप s के बाद apostrophe लगाकर बनता है: “students’.”

qe: Which noun is usually uncountable in standard English?
qh: मानक अंग्रेज़ी में कौन-सी संज्ञा सामान्यतः अगणनीय है?
e: “Advice” is normally uncountable; we say “some advice” or “a piece of advice.”
eh: “Advice” सामान्यतः अगणनीय है; “some advice” या “a piece of advice” कहते हैं।

qe: Choose the grammatically correct comparison.
qh: व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही तुलना चुनिए।
o: This route is shorter than the old one.
This route is more shorter than the old one.
This route is shortest than the old one.
This route is short than the old one.
This route shorter the old one.
oe: This route is shorter than the old one.
This route is more shorter than the old one.
This route is shortest than the old one.
This route is short than the old one.
This route shorter the old one.
oh: यह मार्ग पुराने मार्ग से छोटा है।
यह मार्ग पुराने से अधिक छोटा है।
यह मार्ग पुराने से सबसे छोटा है।
e: “Shorter than” is the correct comparative form; do not add “more” to the -er form.
eh: तुलनात्मक रूप “shorter than” सही है; -er रूप के साथ “more” न जोड़ें।

qe: Choose the correct sentence.
qh: सही वाक्य चुनिए।
o: The information was useful to the whole class.
The informations were useful to the whole class.
The information were useful to all class.
An information was useful to class.
oe: The information was useful to the whole class.
The informations were useful to the whole class.
The information were useful to all class.
An information was useful to class.
oh: जानकारी पूरी कक्षा के लिए उपयोगी थी।
जानकारियाँ पूरी कक्षा के लिए उपयोगी थे।
जानकारी सब कक्षा के लिए उपयोगी थे।
एक जानकारी कक्षा को उपयोगी था।
e: “Information” is uncountable and takes a singular verb in standard English.
eh: मानक अंग्रेज़ी में “Information” अगणनीय है और एकवचन क्रिया लेता है।

qe: Read: “Asha planted two seeds in separate pots. One pot received sunlight; the other stayed in a dark cupboard.” Which factor is Asha comparing?
qh: पढ़िए: “आशा ने अलग-अलग गमलों में दो बीज लगाए। एक गमले को धूप मिली; दूसरा अँधेरी अलमारी में रहा।” आशा किस कारक की तुलना कर रही है?
e: The two pots differ in light exposure, so light is the factor being compared.
eh: दोनों गमलों में प्रकाश की उपलब्धता अलग है, इसलिए आशा प्रकाश कारक की तुलना कर रही है।
